source_tradition_boundary: Moody modern psychomanteum,Dee/Casaubon historical edited accounts,obsidian material/object biography andordinary contemplative reflection are separate profiles,not interchangeable rituals. Source testimony andparticipants felt experiences do not independently establish contact with deceased people.

feasibility.first_scope: One completely verified source-bounded guided reflective procedure andmanual experience journal,or a clearly original editorial contemplative profile if historical procedure remains incomplete. No clairvoyance/contact detector,forced apparition or therapeutic certification.
feasibility.reflective_environments: Require declared surface/lighting/background/angle/context fields andexplicit unknowns. Exact Moody room dimensions/positioning/preparation/duration/debriefing need original passage verification;metadata is insufficient to invent them.
feasibility.journaling: Raw user words,observed reflections,subjective/imagined/uncertain/no imagery,uncertainty andpersonal associations are compatible conceptual categories. Preserve statements about encounters as attributed reports;never translate a reported presence into objectively detected spirits.
feasibility.interpretation: Direct source procedure,personal associations,editorial prompts andunsupported conclusions remain separate. No source-complete Mirror symbolic dictionary verified.
feasibility.rights: Modern Reunions/excerpts/article are protected;Cornell explicitly restricts later distribution. Metadata/original notes only now. A permissively cleared historical witness or appropriate permission would be needed for future source-text corpus;no blanket inference from1659 publication or open access.
